action.http_login.description: Enrolled human identity routes through admitted native transactions

errors.refused: Strict credential/origin/body/rate refusals; invalid credential/factor401; enrollment409; committed lock429; operational or unknown503 AUTH_UNCONFIRMED

preconditions: Owner supplies actual socket ConnectInfo and lifetime-admitted executor with safe logging/connection retirement
No default product data opener or writer authority; existing migration/release gates remain binding
postconditions: Pending MFA is not a session; known factor commit alone issues browser-session cookie
Current session is token-free metadata with current authority checks and rollback without refresh or cleanup
Logout clears cookies only after known success or explicitly local absent-credential cleanup
Unknown transactions never issue cookies or claim revocation; mutation client retries disabled
external_effects: Trusted lifetime-admitted handlers alone perform native MFA and logout transactions
Session read rolls back; no default filesystem/workspace authority or automatic retry

authorization.rationale: Preserve MFA authority, current facts, no mixed-credential fallback, known commit before cookies and truthful uncertain logout.
